name: A Masquerade in the Woods
source:
[b]We would like to cordially invite you to attend A Masquerade B̶a̶l̶l̶ IN THE WOODS[/b]

He just wants to go home. He just wants to see his brother again. He just wants to know how he ended up in a dark, ash covered forest. But when Cody finds himself involved in a murder investigation with his actions in the center, a group of vigilantes rope him into the disturbing puzzle of what's really going on, and along the way discover that crime fighting isn’t as easy as the comic books portray it.

[i]A Masquerade in the Woods[/i] is a horror/mystery focused visual novel set in the town of Blackmill, where strange disappearances has caused a group of individuals to take matters into their own hands.

[From [url=https://packbepackin.itch.io/amw]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[b]诚邀你出席一场化装舞会——不，是在树林里[/b]

他只想回家，只想再见弟弟一面，只想弄清自己为何会身处一片漆黑、覆满灰烬的森林。但Cody意外卷入一起谋杀案，自己的行动更成为案件焦点；一群义警将他拉进这起事件背后的骇人谜团。一路上，他也会发现，打击犯罪并不像漫画里描写得那么容易。

[i]《A Masquerade in the Woods》[/i]是一部恐怖悬疑视觉小说，故事发生在Blackmill小镇。怪异的失踪事件让一群人决定亲自查明真相。

[来源：[url=https://packbepackin.itch.io/amw]Itch.io[/url]]
